verdict.rationale: AMD documents Linux x86-64 support for the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) and bundles an amdgpu driver with its Linux ROCm install. It also describes ROCm as a primarily open-source stack that can be built from source with TheRock. However, nothing in the pack states that the amdgpu kernel module is open source or upstream in the Linux kernel; the openness claims cover the user-space ROCm stack. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation that the kernel driver is open-source or upstreamed, and independent or hands-on corroboration of running the card on an open driver.
